privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how the Hard 21 app collects, uses, and protects your information. By using the App, you agree to the practices described below.

sections.heading: 1. Information We Collect
bullets: Account information (via Supabase): name, email, profile image, account ID.
In-app usage data (via Supabase): username, challenge progress, points and level, completed tasks, store purchases, ad-reward history, and attendance data.
Profile photo: stored securely if uploaded.
Advertising information (via Google AdMob): device advertising identifiers and technical data used to serve ads.
Technical data: basic device and OS information.

sections.heading: 2. How We Use Your Information
sections.body: To operate the App and save progress, enable secure sign-in, power leaderboards and interactive features, display ads and grant their rewards, run the attendance feature, and improve the App.

sections.heading: 3. Information Sharing
sections.body: We do not sell your personal information. We share it only with essential providers: Supabase (authentication and data storage), Google (sign-in), Google AdMob (advertising).

sections.heading: 4. Advertising & Advertising ID
sections.body: The App uses Google AdMob, including rewarded ads. Google may use your Advertising ID to personalize and measure ads. You can reset it or opt out in device settings.

sections.heading: 5. Data Security
sections.body: We take reasonable measures to protect your data via encrypted connections and trusted providers. No method is 100% secure.

sections.heading: 6. Data Retention & Account Deletion
sections.body: We retain your data while your account is active. Request deletion via the email below.

sections.heading: 7. Children's Privacy
sections.body: The App is not directed to children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect their data.

sections.heading: 8. Your Rights
sections.body: You may access, correct, or delete your data, and opt out of personalized ads in device settings.

sections.heading: 9. Changes to This Policy
sections.body: We may update this policy and post changes here with an updated date.
